A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same weight-normalization study. Their main text, figures, equations, and complete appendices are readable; moved and renumbered material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: V1 reports original synthetic matrix-sensing experiments, optimization-trajectory analyses, and two image-reconstruction experiments in Figures 1–4.

after.justification: V2 retains original empirical results and adds preconditioned-method comparisons, matrix-completion experiments, and a magnitude-constraint ablation in Figures 5–7.

M1.justification: Appendix A.5 introduces PrecRGD, which preconditions the X-gradient using (Theta_t^2 + lambda I)^(-1). Appendix B.1 also proposes an asymmetric representation using two Stiefel factors. These substantively extend the method, although the original Algorithm 1 remains unchanged.

E1.justification: V2 adds matrix-completion tasks with combinatorial observation patterns and spurious local minima (Appendix B.2, Figure 6). This extends v1's Gaussian matrix sensing and image-reconstruction coverage to a distinct task and optimization environment.

E2.justification: V1's empirical comparisons center on vanilla GD. V2 evaluates PrecGD and ScaledGD(lambda) alongside GD and the WN methods in Figure 5. Figure 7 additionally introduces a diagonal/nonnegative-Theta comparator.

E3.justification: Figure 2a changes condition numbers from {10,20,30} to {50,75,100} and measurements from 3,000 to 60,000. Figure 2b changes m from 20 to 300, target rank from 3 to 5, and measurements from 3,000 to 50,000. Full-rank settings also change, while new experiments introduce preconditioner-specific settings and completion-success evaluation.

E4.justification: V2 adds tests of preconditioning and its interaction with overparameterization, completion success under difficult landscapes and varying perturbations, and an ablation imposing diagonal/nonnegative Theta (Figures 5–7). These investigate questions beyond v1's trajectory, retraction, conditioning, and noise analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version documents experimental run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. V2's completion-success percentages introduce an evaluation metric, without specifying a new uncertainty-estimation procedure or trial count.

E6.justification: V2 replaces several convergence curves under revised settings and adds Figures 5–7. New findings include PrecRGD matching ScaledGD(lambda) at r=40 and accelerating further at r=45, rank-dependent completion success, and stalled convergence with diagonalized Theta. The replaced curves do not establish same-setting improvements over v1.

T1.justification: Theorem 3.2, Lemmas 4.1–4.2, and the existing proof appendices retain their substantive assumptions and bounds. V2 adds a heuristic Hessian derivation motivating PrecRGD and a short asymmetric-factorization derivation, without adding corresponding convergence guarantees.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements, and conclusion retain the claims of linear convergence, exponential improvement over vanilla GD, polynomial benefits from overparameterization, and two-phase optimization behavior. The additional appendix evidence does not redefine these core claims.

C2.justification: V2 discusses compatibility with preconditioning, acknowledges accelerated baselines' better condition-number dependence, and argues for broader applicability. It also interprets diagonal/nonnegative constraints as potentially harmful and discusses limited higher-rank completion success. These add substantive explanations and applicability qualifications.

D1.justification: New Appendices G.3–G.5 specify regularization choices, comparator-specific initializations and step sizes, reuse of the completion benchmark's code, and SVD/thresholding for the constrained variant. These provide substantial implementation information for the added experiments; existing image and trajectory setups are retained.

R1.justification: Appendix A.5 substantially expands positioning against PrecGD and ScaledGD(lambda), comparing initialization requirements, convergence, sample complexity, and overparameterization benefits. V2 also adds references to Tong et al. (2021), Recht (2011), and Yalcin et al. (2022), supporting the new comparisons and extensions.

P1.justification: Most existing prose and proofs remain closely matched. V2 renames Section 2 and the 'initial phase,' moves the full-rank discussion into Section 5.2, expands the appendix structure, and adds reproducibility and LLM-use statements. The main narrative is not extensively rewritten.

P2.justification: V2 adds Figures 5–7 and reorganizes Figure 2 into three panels, incorporating the revised full-rank experiment formerly displayed in Figure 3c. The remaining Figure 3 panels are enlarged, and typography and page layout change throughout. Table 1 and the image-reconstruction panels are retained.

improvement.justification: Compared with v1's GD-centered validation, v2 adds relevant accelerated baselines and a useful test of the unrestricted Theta parameterization. These improve empirical context, but the additions have reporting defects: unspecified completion trial counts, an overgeneralized Figure 6b summary, and the dimensionally inconsistent Y^T Y-A residual in G.3. The central theoretical results are retained.
